call_guidance.calendar_input: Date labels use the explicit question_calendar/candidate_calendar, default proleptic Gregorian. Read calendar_conversion and analysis_context.input_calendar/input_date before explaining normalized datetimes.
call_guidance.candidate_inputs: Use the recorded candidate instant, timezone and coordinates; this is not an interval-wide optimum search.
call_guidance.clock_input: Use explicit candidate_clock_basis only from confirmed clock evidence: civil / local_mean_solar / local_apparent_solar.
call_guidance.clock_seconds: Use candidate_second only for confirmed whole-second labels0..59; omitted defaults to0. Do not invent unknown seconds.
call_guidance.evidence_boundary: 读取 moon、axes、factors 与 unresolved_factors；婚嫁指定 Ramesey 时读取 marriage_significators 的原典条件。
call_guidance.hour_origin: Use candidate_hour_origin=noon only for confirmed noon-based clock-hour labels such as Lilly1647 pp30-31 ephemeris tables. Default midnight preserves modern labels. Noon0=same-date12:00; noon12..23=next-date00:00..11:00.
call_guidance.interpretation_boundary: 以用户明确的活动需求、备选窗口和传统方法逐条件解读。
call_guidance.physical_epoch: 太阳时反解的有效时刻可能落在UTC闰秒。converted_utc可含23:59:60；按clock_conversion.utc_representation区分标签与datetime可表示性，计算使用原生TT/UT1。不能把不能解析datetime说成计算失败，也不能将秒60截断、平滑或移到次日；数值标签精度不代表实测钟时精度。
call_guidance.ut1_source: ut1_source默认swiss_delta_t；显式iers_c04使用固定IERS20 C04最终每日合成值，仅覆盖1962-01-01 00:00至2026-09-19 00:00 UTC，需要UT1的时刻超范围拒绝；地心TT黄经事件试算不需要UT1。连续TT上先去除62项zonal模型，对UT1-TAI作四点Lagrange插值，再恢复zonal并加入声明的日内模型；不要重复叠加回执中的zonal项。

calculation_conditions.purpose: 依据明确选定的传统口径解读，并保留未决条件。
calculation_conditions.when: 逐项比较候选时刻的行星、月亮条件、实际角点与未决因素。

calendar_input.purpose: 核对显式儒略历／延伸格里历日期、转换后的本地钟时与实际TT/UT1；不推断地区改历、旧式年份或历史钟时，不把日期换算当原图复现。

clock_input.purpose: 核对已确认的整秒钟面、民用／地方平太阳／地心视太阳时、历法与正午进位及同一物理TT/UT1；省略秒沿用0不代表记录精度，不拟合未知原书钟时。

hour_origin.purpose: 核对已确认的午夜／正午起算小时标签：原历法日期、原小时与进位后的标准钟面分别读取，再看实际TT／UT1；不推断原图口径，不当作时区修正或实际持续时长。

physical_epoch.description: 输入钟时、原生TT/UT1及UTC显示标签；太阳时物理轴保留秒60。普通civil分支utc_representation可为null，未宣称原始资料或实测EOP已认证。

ut1_input.purpose: 核对明确选择的模型或IERS20 C04 UT1来源、固定覆盖期、源文件名称与版本、插值区间与未应用修正；盘面与地平计算仍要求覆盖内UT1；地心TT黄经事件不外推UT1即可跨边界搜索，未取得瞬时观测误差。

input.description: Request model for the 择日 (electional) tool — chart cast at the candidate moment.

candidate_calendar.description: Explicit calendar for candidate date labels; CE Jan1 years, no automatic regional reform or old-style year/clock reconstruction. Normalize date labels before applying timezone.
candidate_calendar.title: Candidate Calendar

candidate_clock_basis.description: Explicit candidate clock: civil, local mean solar (UT1 + east longitude/360), or geocentric local apparent solar (adds EOT). Solar labels require timezone_name omitted/null; unknown original clocks stay unknown.
candidate_clock_basis.title: Candidate Clock Basis

candidate_hour_origin.description: Explicit hour-label origin: midnight(default) hour0=00:00; noon hour0=same-date12:00 and hour12..23=next-date00:00..11:00. Confirm the source convention first; independent of civil/LMT/LAT, never an elapsed duration, timezone offset or automatic historical inference. Normalize calendar/day carry before applying timezone.
candidate_hour_origin.title: Candidate Hour Origin

candidate_second.description: Confirmed whole second of the candidate clock label (0-59); omitted defaults to0. Fractional seconds and second60 are unsupported. Input resolution does not certify the original record's accuracy.
candidate_second.title: Candidate Second

candidate_year.description: Year of the candidate moment being evaluated
candidate_year.title: Candidate Year

house_system.description: House system, any convention (SE letter / key / integer code 0..8); Regiomontanus (R, code 2) is traditional for horary and elections. Explicit values must be supported letters/names or integer codes0..8; unknown, blank, boolean and floating-point selections are rejected without substitution. Gauquelin (G) has36 clockwise sectors and is unavailable here.
house_system.title: House System

latitude.description: Latitude where the chart is cast (optional when place is given)
latitude.title: Latitude

longitude.description: Longitude where the chart is cast (optional when place is given)
longitude.title: Longitude

place.description: 起盘地点名称（支持离线地名库自动补全 longitude / latitude 及民用时钟下的 timezone_name）
place.title: Place

search_window_hours.description: Optional candidate window scanner duration (hours, 0..168). When > 0, scans 1-hour steps forward from candidate datetime for top non-VOC, benefic-supported windows.
search_window_hours.title: Search Window Hours

timezone_name.description: Civil timezone (IANA or UTC offset). Omitted/null with civil preserves legacy +08:00; supply the known zone explicitly. Solar clock bases must omit/null this field to prevent double correction.
timezone_name.title: Timezone Name

topic_id.description: Undertaking type, selecting the rule pack: marriage/business/move_in/buy_property/trade/buy_car/contract/travel/job_hunt/general; 不提供医疗择时
topic_id.title: Topic Id

ut1_source.description: Earth-rotation source: modeled Swiss Delta T(default), or pinned IERS20 C04 final daily data,1962-01-01T00:00UTC..2026-09-19T00:00UTC. C04 uses declared TT interpolation and tidal corrections; managed houses/horizons also apply polar motion and source-qualified celestial-pole offsets. No out-of-range prediction,extrapolation or model fallback; no clock-record or absolute-accuracy certification. Geocentric TT longitude-event searches need no trial UT1; houses and horizons require covered epochs.
ut1_source.title: Ut1 Source
